mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 50% of instances when RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 70% of instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 50% of instances when INDPRO increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% YoY, the combination signals a mismatch between inflation and monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 50% of instances when HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals extreme monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 70% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.
